integrity: Complete standalone proof and exact rational checker supplied. Finite checks corroborate analytical inequalities but do not prove universal statements. Independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem for real independent-sign bilinear chaos, unequal rectangular dimensions, one missing corner, fourth moment only. The square case and other coefficients/laws/exponents are not covered. Origin comparison has residual unindexed literature risk.
title: Sharp rectangular puncture norms and complete-row localization in real bilinear Walsh spaces
